subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` mode for private `message_tool_only` finals, or should the fix move to a different default-on/no-config or strict-silence policy?
rationale: The code path is reviewable, but the remaining choice changes the privacy and operator contract for private final text across source channels, which automation cannot decide.

options.title: Accept opt-in recovery after live proof
options.body: Keep this PR's default-false config surface, require redacted real external channel proof, and merge only after the one-shot retry behavior is demonstrated.

options.title: Prefer the default-on successor shape
options.body: Move the canonical fix to #99536 or a refreshed replacement after it is made mergeable and receives current proof/review.

options.title: Keep strict tool-only semantics
options.body: Reject recovery and keep the current contract that no message-tool call means no source reply, relying on stronger prompts, stronger models, or automatic visible replies.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in recovery after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's default-false config surface, require redacted real external channel proof, and merge only after the one-shot retry behavior is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core delivery/privacy product-boundary call, and steipete is the strongest available owner signal from the merged diagnostics PR and current repository policy.
